description: This Java source file defines a Hibernate interceptor class 'DropMillisecondsHibernateInterceptor' which ensures that Date fields in Hibernate entities have millisecond precision removed before being persisted or updated in the database. It specifically addresses issues related to MySQL versions prior to 5.6 where DATETIME fields are only precise to the second. The class integrates with Hibernate's lifecycle callbacks to modify date fields by truncating milliseconds to avoid rounding errors and inconsistencies in date storage.

classes.name: DropMillisecondsHibernateInterceptor
classes.description: A Hibernate interceptor that truncates milliseconds from Date fields before saving or updating entities, ensuring compatibility with MySQL DATETIME fields that are only precise to the second.

methods.name: onFlushDirty
methods.description: Overrides Hibernate's method to modify the state of an entity before updating, removing milliseconds from date fields.

methods.name: onSave
methods.description: Overrides Hibernate's method to modify the entity state before saving, removing milliseconds from date fields.

methods.name: removeMillisecondsFromDateFields
methods.description: Helper method that iterates through an array of field values, and if a Date object with non-zero milliseconds is found, replaces it with a truncated version with milliseconds set to zero.
